title: 黑石总裁格雷：15亿人口，为何只有10支板球队？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So you've gone viral on LinkedIn with your running videos.
segments.zh: 你在领英上因为跑步视频火了。

segments.en: Tell me what's one idea that's come to you while running.
segments.zh: 跑步时有什么想法冒出来？

segments.en: I like to formulate ideas, themes.
segments.zh: 我喜欢构思一些想法和主题。

segments.en: I've spent a lot of time thinking about AI and AI infrastructure.
segments.zh: 我花了很多时间思考AI和AI基础设施。

segments.en: I listen to a lot of podcasts, books on tape.
segments.zh: 我听很多播客和有声书。

segments.en: And I think it's helped frame my thinking about AI as a transformative technology.
segments.zh: 这帮助我构建了对AI作为变革性技术的思考。

segments.en: Now, what's one area of your life or your business that you will never hand over to AI?
segments.zh: 你生活中或业务中哪个领域永远不会交给AI？

segments.en: Oh my gosh, your personal relationships. I think that will always be a human interaction.
segments.zh: 天哪，你的人际关系。我认为那永远是人类互动。

segments.en: I don't think I'll have AI calling my kids for the update.
segments.zh: 我不认为我会让AI给我的孩子打电话更新近况。

segments.en: What's one asset you think will be more valuable in the future?
segments.zh: 你认为未来哪种资产会更有价值？

segments.en: I would say scarce assets. It could be beachfront property.
segments.zh: 我会说是稀缺资产，比如海滨地产。

segments.en: Other things art. I think those things in a world of abundance will have a lot of value.
segments.zh: 还有艺术品。在富足的世界里，这些东西会很有价值。

segments.en: We invested in the cricket team here in Bangalore in India.
segments.zh: 我们**了印度班加罗尔的一支板球队。

segments.en: And we did that because it's a country with 1.5 billion people.
segments.zh: 我们这么做是因为这个国家有15亿人口。

segments.en: And there are only 10 cricket teams.
I don't know if you've been looking at all the social media discourse about iced coffee.
segments.zh: 不知道你有没有关注社交媒体上关于冰咖啡的讨论。

segments.en: Would you give a job to someone who brings an iced coffee to an interview?
segments.zh: 你会给面试时带冰咖啡的人一份工作吗？

segments.en: I don't think I'd hold it against them. I know that's quite a controversy.
segments.zh: 我觉得我不会因此对他们有意见。我知道这争议挺大。
